{{Quote|Next up are the Mummers. Go to their bunker and prepare to tap their communication antenna.|[[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Mercious Bragg|Bragg]], to a trooper|<ref name="SWG:TtCotFMCG" />}}
The '''Mummer bunker''' was the base of the [[Mummers]] criminal organization, located on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] a relatively short distance south of the city of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]].

==History==
{{Quote|It's time to hit the Mummers at their base. If we, and by we I mean you, can hit them hard enough, the Mummers will be unable to consider future terrorist attacks.|Sergeant [[Harriet Brunser|Brunser]], to a trooper|<ref name="SWG:BTttT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Bring Terror to the Terrorists|Naboo}}</ref>}}
[[File:MummerBunkerInterior.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The interior of the Mummer bunker]]
Following the Mummer [[Terrorist attack in Theed|terrorist attack]] in Theed, the bunker was [[Raid on the Mummer bunker|raided]] by troopers of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] led by [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Harriet Brunser|Brunser]]. The RSF troopers found a number of biochemical weapons that had been cached among the many illegal items that had been stockpiled within the base. The bunker [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Jaye Hawkson]] and the Mummer [[Chief Scientist/Legends|Chief Scientist]] [[Crimsol Vaighn]] were killed during the attack.<ref name="SWG:BTttT" />

After those events, the Mummers continued to use the bunker. The wanted murderer [[Hunnos Jarkey]] briefly took refuge in the Mummer bunker after he escaped the Royal Naboo Security Forces.<ref name="SWG:CtEM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Catch the Escaped Murderer|Naboo}}</ref>

Later, a spacer sent by [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]] entered the Mummer bunker to retrieve one of the pieces of a broken [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] artifact scattered by the [[Ultragungans]] in various areas of Naboo.<ref name="SWG:RaSPotsGA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Recover all Six Pieces of the scattered Gungan Artifact|Naboo}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Mummer bunker appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TtCotFMCG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Mummer bunker was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
